exposure: distance between trocars and target organ
outcome: intraoperative robotic events (collisions, need for detaching instruments, moving trays)
cohort: 19 patients undergoing robotic surgery for benign gynaecological diseases.
finding: The Versius surgical system was found to be a safe option for benign gynaecological surgery, with specific recommendations for trocar placement distances (19 cm for bipolar and 15 cm for scissors from target organ) to avoid collisions.
